financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Underwritten public offering of 15,681,818 shares including full exercise of option shares, closed March 7, 2023
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: On March 7, 2023, the Offering closed and the Company completed the sale and issuance of an aggregate of 15,681,818 Shares, including the exercise in full of the Option Shares.
